camera.occlusion_reason: No unique selected pending material target observed

initial_state.com_reference: Jolt direct-state origin + world COM offset
initial_state.contact_work_scope: Applied hand and foot linear forces only; excludes ground and torque work
initial_state.saturation_scope: Any shared hand, foot, assist or resultant budget >=99%; not actuator target saturation
initial_state.scope: finite difference includes real gravity/contact impulses; diagnostic, not a comfort threshold
initial_state.support_relative_scope: One retained material anchor only; multiple/changed supports are not an exact common reference

recording.compression: plain streaming JSONL; offline gzip available

reference_frame: accepted supported intent frozen at onset; configured support axis for no-input tasks

rotation.axis_scope: support-relative scalar supplied by snapshot; not inferred roll

support.work_scope: signed F dot actual application point velocity; not whole-system energy
